steps.desc: 1. The user enters a non-third-party platform link in "Add your Linktree URL" and then clicks "Continue".

steps.desc: 2. The user did not fill in the Pear shop link in the BIO of Linktree, then entered the Linktree link in "Add your Linktree URL" and then clicked "Continue".

cases.name: Verify the migration tool's Edu popup
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront / Migrate content tool
cases.desc: KAT-7974

steps.desc: 1. The user registers and logs in to pear through the promoter invitation link and clicks "Customize".
steps.result:
1. When entering the "Customize shop" page, the message "EDU:" appears.
title: Migrate Your Content to Pear in Minutes
text: Move your content from Linktree or Komi to Pear in one go—just note it’s a one-time transfer and future updates won’t sync automatically.
CTA: Not now
CTA: Start migrating

steps.desc: 2. The promoter clicks "Not now" or "X", then clicks "<".
steps.result: 2. The user closed this EDU pop-up and returned to the shop page.
3. After clicking "Start migrating", the pop-up will be closed and the user will automatically be scrolled to the "Migrate content tool".

steps.desc: 4. The promoter clicks "<", then clicks "Customize" again, then modifies the shop name to "test linktree", and finally clicks "Publish".
steps.result: 4. The shop name was successfully changed to "test linktree".
5. Since the shop information has been saved, the EDU pop-up will also be permanently closed.

add "Colors" and "Theme"

steps.desc: 1. The user clicks "Customize", then click "Import from other platforms", and clicks "Move from Linktree".
steps.result:
1. When entering the "Migrate Content Tool" page, the appears: 

Add your Linktree URL

What do you want to migrate?
Profile, Profile, Content

steps.desc: 2. Copy the homepage link of Linktree, then return to Pear, paste the homepage link of Linktree into the "Add your Linktree URL" input field, and then click "Continue".
steps.result: 2. Successfully synchronized the Profile, Social, and Content information of linktree to pear shop at one time.

steps.desc: 3. (Komi)Log into another account, enter the Customize shop page, repeat the migration process this time migrating Profile, Social, Module, Content, Colors and Theme in sequence.
steps.result: 3. Successfully synchronized the Profile, Social, Module, Content information, Colors and Theme of linktree to pear shop sequentially.

cases.name: Verify the color and theme coverage logic of the migration tool
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Storefront / Migrate content tool
cases.desc:
KAT-9184

add "Colors" and "Theme"

steps.desc: 1. When registering as a partner/coseller, import the colors and themes, and then log in to check the themes.
steps.result: 1. The color, theme and the linked content are consistent.

steps.desc: 2. During the registration process, import the colors and themes. Then, at the final step of registration, select another theme, and finally log in to check the theme.
steps.result: 2. The color is consistent with the imported link, and the theme is the one selected during registration.

steps.desc: 3. During the registration process for partner/coseller, do not import the link. Instead, at the final step of registration, select the topic, and then log in to check the topic.
steps.result: 3. Color, theme should be consistent with that specified during registration.

steps.desc: 4. During the registration process for partner/coseller, do not import the link. Select the appropriate theme, log in, then import the link, and finally check for any changes in color and theme.
steps.result: 4. The color, theme, and the linked content should be consistent.

steps.desc: 5. During registration, import the colors and themes. After logging in, change the theme in the "Style" section, and then verify the changes in the colors and themes.
steps.result: 5. The color is consistent with the imported link, and the theme is set as "Style" when the appropriate option is selected.

steps.desc: 6. After logging in, import the link. During the import process, do not select the color and theme options. Then, check the color and theme.
